product.title: Sunset and Night Photography in Arches National Park

description.text: Arches National Park—an International Dark Sky Park—is especially beautiful after the sun goes down and the crowds depart. Visit three (or more) spots for golden hour and night photography at lesser-known locales. Stops include Arches National Park Visitor Center. Great for beginner and intermediate photographers; practice astrophotography once the Milky Way emerges. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Arches National Park experience without coordinating timed entry, trailheads, or backcountry logistics on their own.
